mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_abac_policy ( id, tenant_id, policy_code, policy_name, resource_type, operation, effect, priority, condition_expr, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{policyCode}, #{policyName}, #{resourceType}, #{operation}, #{effect}, #{priority}, #{conditionExpr}, #{description}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, policy_code, policy_name, resource_type, operation, effect, priority, condition_expr, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_abac_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, policy_code, policy_name, resource_type, operation, effect, priority, condition_expr, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_abac_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND resource_type IN (#{resourceType}, '*') AND operation IN (#{operation}, '*') ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC

SELECT id, tenant_id, policy_code, policy_name, resource_type, operation, effect, priority, condition_expr, description, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iam_abac_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM iam_abac_policy WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id}
